title: 373. H-Index

examples.explanation: Three papers have at least 3 citations each (3, 6, 5).
No paper has a citation, so h is 0.

hints: Sort the counts, then the best h is the largest h with at least h values >= h.
After sorting ascending, citations[n-h] >= h is the check for each candidate h.
A counting bucket also works since values are bounded.
